item.title: The Zone Extra | March 19, 2026
item.description: This week in central Indiana high school sports saw boys basketball regional championships, a coaching change at Fishers, Gracyn Gilliard being named Indiana Miss Basketball, and much more.

item.title: Center Grove’s Gracyn Gilliard shares reaction to being named Indiana Miss Basketball
item.description: Gracyn Gilliard of Center Grove girls basketball was named the 2026 Indiana Miss Basketball after leading her team to the 4A state championship with an unbeaten 29-0 record.

item.title: At Trump’s request, Netanyahu to pause attacks on Iran’s offshore gas field
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has pledged to refrain from further attacks on Iran's South Pars gas field at the request of President Donald Trump. Meanwhile, Iran continues to launch attacks on oil and gas facilities around the Gulf, causing fuel prices to soar and threatening global energy markets.

item.title: Economic boost expected as Indianapolis hosts Final Four
item.description: Indianapolis is preparing to host the NCAA Men's Final Four and other basketball championships, expecting 70,000 visitors and a $400 million economic impact, with downtown businesses preparing for a surge in customers.

item.title: Missing persons’ advocate calls Indiana database inadequate
item.description: Indiana's missing persons database is lacking detail and is difficult to search, which some say hinders efforts to locate missing people.

item.title: Butler University creates fund to back arts organizations
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — Butler University is using shows at Clowes Memorial Hall and its other venues to build what it says will be long-term help for the performing arts in the city it calls home. item.title: Indy Parks breaks ground on WISH Park renovation
item.description: Mayor Joe Hogsett, City-County Councilor Leroy Robinson, and Indy Parks broke ground on a renovation of WISH Park, which is part of a $150 million plan to upgrade over a third of Indianapolis's 218 parks.

item.title: Weight-loss treatment is on the verge of a dramatic shift – again
item.description: The FDA recently approved the Wegovy pill, a GLP-1 weight-loss drug, which has become wildly popular and is estimated to be part of the daily regimen of about 400,000 Americans, with a second pill awaiting approval and more powerful drugs in clinical trials.

item.title: University of Alabama student found dead at Barcelona beach
item.description: The body of 20-year-old James "Jimmy" Gracey, a college student from Illinois, was found in the water off a Barcelona beach, and Catalan police are investigating the cause of death.

item.title: Purdue commit Luke Ertel shares what he’s learned from Braden Smith
item.description: Luke Ertel of Mount Vernon is looking forward to joining the Purdue family next season, as he and his team prepare to take on Decatur Central in the semi-state semifinal on Saturday.
